verdict.pair_reasons:
X vs Y — Y, narrowly. Y states three verified key-floor items X omits entirely: (a) the quoted-`--model` bypass (`handoff-fire.sh --model "claude-fable-5-1"` presents `"` against `[A-Za-z0-9._-]+` at :75, so frontier_fire_model returns 1 and :97 exits 0 — I reproduced this empirically); (b) the gate's OWN stale self-citation at hooks/frontier-spawn-gate.sh:27 → scripts/handoff-fire.sh:9303-9311, which is hf_inflight_key() and carries no model logic (the key names this a trap; X's §8 scoped itself to citations INTO the gate and so structurally could not see it); (c) skills/frontier-routing/SKILL.md:41, the doc sentence true of the CODE and false of the LIVE WIRING that brief item 8 asks for by shape — X answered only half that sub-question (CLAUDE.global.md correctly caveated, the ladder doc false-of-code). X also never cites scripts/handoff-fire.sh at a line at all, missing K19's alias resolution. Against that, X has real unique value Y lacks: four further stale doc citations I opened and confirmed exact (p15-escalation.md:44, A5-harness.md:357, A6-mechanics.md:245/:500), the config/hook-chains.d/pretooluse-bash corroborating artifact, and the sharpest single find in any of the three — L1-census.md:62 asserting the cap refusal says `--model claude-opus-5` when :138 says `--model opus` and bats:155 forbids exactly that string. Y is dragged down by one flatly false sentence ('Both refusal texts also say "Agent spawns and frontier session FIRES share one budget"' — :140 has no such clause) and three wrong-line citations (:700 for a value on :699, :689-690 for a phrase on :691, :548 for a literal on :549). X's worst is one fabricated quote (line 5's text attributed to :23, with a correct verdict) plus a miscounted CC_LADDER grep. Net: three missing floor items outweigh one extra sub-item's depth.

X vs Z — Z, clearly. Z has everything Y has over X (M5, M8, M10) plus K19 exactly (scripts/handoff-fire.sh:9493, `fable) MODEL="$(_ssot_scalar frontier_access model)"` — the alias and the gate resolving the same SSOT key), plus M11's fuller form (NONLIMIT_RESUME_LADDER.md:585's uncheckable off-repo citation and :66's 'registration is 👤'). Z also carries four verified novel findings X lacks: install.sh's additive merge (:29, :1201-1204, :1216) proving even a fresh install gets only the Agent arm; the `--model=X` overcount (gate counts it at :75, handoff-fire's parser has only `--model)` at :8916, and `grep -- '--model='` over that file returns nothing); agent-teams-enforce.sh:423-426 incrementing BEFORE its refuse branch, making its ':367 Attempts are charged, not admissions' the inverse of the frontier gate's :136-144; and the jq-abstain suite listing the gate at tests/hook-jq-abstain.bats:6 while never testing it, with the session arm being precisely the silent fail-open that suite exists to prevent. X's unique citation audit is genuinely good but is one sub-item against Z's broader, cleaner coverage; Z's only citation defect is a 4-line short range on hf_inflight_key.

Y vs Z — Z. Specific verified differences: Z states K19 exactly (handoff-fire.sh:9493) where Y only reaches the FABLE_EFFECTIVE detector at :10146-10147 and never connects the `fable` alias to frontier_access.model; Z covers M11 fully including :585 and :66 where Y cites only :866; and Y carries a flatly wrong claim I checked against the source — line 140 does NOT contain 'Agent spawns and frontier session FIRES share one budget', so 'Both refusal texts also say' is false, while Z attributes that clause correctly to the session arm alone. Y additionally has three wrong-line citations into model-config.yaml (:700, :689-690, :548) against Z's one short range. Z's unique verified extras (install.sh fresh-install path, the `--model=` overcount, the attempts-vs-admissions inversion, the jq-abstain coverage gap, agents/*.md frontmatter holding only opus×2/sonnet×2) outweigh Y's own good ones (cap=0 semantics, model-config.yaml:512-514's obsolete quoted shape, the CLAUDE_NEXT_MODEL bypass, and the genuinely sharper frontier-run:30-vs-research-subagents:579 distinction, which is the one place Y is more precise than Z).
